=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/alert_inbox_capture.sh:220-226 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `captured_at` comes from `date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ` and is checked against a strict three-digit regex with no fallback. On ubuntu-26.04 runners (Rust uutils coreutils), %3N can come back one digit short.
  WHY: A short reading fails the regex, so capture returns 1 with reason=payload_build. In capture mode the alert silently never reaches the inbox (`|| true`); in route mode it falls back to Telegram. Every reviewer rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high. One reviewer also notes the new dispatch tests become intermittently flaky on ubuntu-26.04 CI.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:34-38 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `tg_helpers.sh` sources `alert_inbox_capture.sh` only from its own directory. The staging list (scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh:57, REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS / OPTIONAL_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS) omits both `alert_inbox_capture.sh` and `truncate_to_utf8_byte_cap.py`.
  WHY: In staged runs `alert_inbox_mode` and `alert_inbox_capture` are never defined, so `_tg_inbox_mode` stays "off". Setting `capture_enabled=true` and releasing therefore captures nothing from the staged review/implement/orchestrate paths, in this repo or in consumers. All four flaggers rated it MAJOR (high). z-ai_glm-5_3-flash deliberately skipped it as a documented later-phase deferral.
- scripts/alert_inbox_capture.sh:278-294 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Capture counts as successful as soon as `repository_dispatch` returns HTTP 204, before the intake stores anything. In route mode, `tg_send_msg` (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:162-166) then suppresses Telegram.
  WHY: If the store later fails (409 twice, source_repo_not_allowed, captured_at_stale, branch bootstrap, HTTP error), the WARNING/ERROR alert is neither stored nor sent to Telegram. This contradicts the routing-table promise at tg_helpers.sh:123-124 of "Telegram when capture fails". All three flaggers rated it MAJOR (high).
- .github/workflows/alert-inbox-intake.yml:58-79 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The "Notify store failure" notice carries only the alert level, source_repo and intake run URL. It omits the original alert message and the source run, and it is sent at "ERROR" through `tg_send_msg_direct`.
  WHY: In route mode the operator cannot recover or locate the lost alert from the notice. With ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=CRITICAL the notice itself is filtered out. Severity is disagreed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 MAJOR, minimax_minimax-m3 NIT; the highest (high) is used.
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:232-241 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The 409 branch retries only once after `sleep $((1 + RANDOM % 3))` and then calls `_alert_inbox_fail conflict`. Intake runs are not serialised (alert-inbox-intake.yml line 35, `group: alert-inbox-intake-${{ github.run_id }}`), so concurrent Contents API PUTs to the `ai/alert-inbox` head collide.
  WHY: In an alert burst the retries collide again and the record is rejected. The sender already got 204 and suppressed Telegram in route mode, so the alert is lost. Severity is disagreed: z-ai_glm-5_3-flash NIT, the others MAJOR; the highest (high) is used.
- changelog.d/9405-review-checkout-epochrealtime-clock.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: This fragment describes the `review_head_checkout_now_ms` EPOCHREALTIME-first change. That change is already on base and already documented in changelog.d/9252-epochrealtime-ms-clock.md:4; this PR only adds a regression test.
  WHY: At release CHANGELOG.md gets two overlapping entries for the same fix, citing #9405 and #9252. All reviewers rated it NIT (low).
- .github/workflows/alert-inbox-intake.yml:23-35 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Every captured alert starts one GitHub-hosted intake job, with no batching. The per-run concurrency group coalesces nothing, and the PR body has no §26 jobs-per-event justification.
  WHY: Alert storms happen when the pipeline is already degraded, so intake jobs would take slots from the shared runner pool (the 2026-11-11 queue-jam failure mode). Severity is disagreed: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite MAJOR, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash NIT; the highest (high) is used. Two reviewers note it is mitigated while both switches ship false. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 declined to flag it as explicitly accepted at docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md:630-631.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/alert_inbox_capture.sh:lines 221-226 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `captured_at` relies on `date` %3N printing exactly three digits. On ubuntu-26.04 (uutils) %3N can be one digit short (#9240; see scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1559-1562, scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:446-449, scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh:29-31, scripts/review_autofix_step_checkout_pr_head_branch.sh:43-46, which read EPOCHREALTIME first). This helper has no fallback.
  WHY: The regex fails, so capture returns 1 with reason=payload_build. In capture mode `|| true` hides it and the alert never reaches the inbox, which breaks the Phase 1 "Done" criterion. The new tests become intermittently flaky (test_routing_table, test_record_fields, test_captured_alert_is_stored_as_one_record, `_kinds(...)[0]` IndexError). Proposed fix: build the timestamp from EPOCHREALTIME and keep `date` as the fallback for bash < 5.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:lines 34-38; scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh:57 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Staged steps source tg_helpers.sh from SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR (.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml lines 4523, 4959, 5377, 5440, 5533, 5692), but staging omits alert_inbox_capture.sh and truncate_to_utf8_byte_cap.py. `_alert_inbox_cap_file` would return 2 (truncate_unavailable) even if the helper were staged.
  WHY: Rollout step 2 (plan line 644) captures nothing from staged paths, contradicting Constraints §14 (docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md:167-169). No phase in the plan stages these files. Proposed fix: add both to the staging list (about 2 lines).
- scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:lines 234-240; .github/workflows/alert-inbox-intake.yml line 35 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The 409 branch retries once after a 1-3 s sleep. The `group: alert-inbox-intake-${{ github.run_id }}` setting never serialises intake runs, so parallel PUTs to the ai/alert-inbox head conflict.
  WHY: A second 409 means outcome=failed reason=conflict. The sender already got 204 and in route mode skipped Telegram, so the alert is lost. Proposed fix: up to 4 attempts with `sl
